Simple as the shop itself

How ordering works

1

Send the item on WhatsApp

Tap the button under any product. The name and price are already typed into your message — just press send.

2

We confirm weight and total

Brass is sold by weight, so we send a photo of the exact piece with its final price and delivery charge.

3

Pay by UPI, or cash at delivery

Pay the UPI ID we send, or keep cash ready for the delivery boy. Packing photo goes to you before dispatch.

No card gateway, no account

Delivery & payment

Everything is arranged over WhatsApp and paid the way you already pay at the shop.

Where we deliver

  • Moradabad city — free home delivery on orders above ₹999, usually the same evening. Below that, ₹60.
  • Delhi NCR & western UP — 2 to 3 working days by surface courier. Flat ₹120.
  • Rest of India — 4 to 6 working days. Charge depends on weight; we tell you the exact figure before you pay.
  • Bill and warranty slip go inside every parcel. Keep it for polishing and re-kalai service.

How you can pay

  • UPI — PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm or any UPI app. We send a QR and the ID.
  • Cash on delivery — available across Moradabad and for courier orders up to ₹5,000.
  • Bank transfer — for wedding and shop orders, NEFT details on request.
UPI Cash on delivery NEFT / IMPS

We do not take card payments online and we never ask for an OTP. If anyone claiming to be from our shop asks for one, please call us first.

RT
Our workshop

Forty-seven years on the same lane

My grandfather opened a small stall near Peetal Basti in 1978 with two workers and one furnace. We still cast, hammer and polish in the same lane — the counter in front is only the last step.

Because we make what we sell, we can change a size, engrave a name, or match a piece you already own at home. Send a photo on WhatsApp and we will tell you honestly whether we can do it.

Rakesh Trivedi Third generation, Trivedi Brass & Copper

Wedding, temple or shop order?

Fifty thalis for a bhandara, return gifts for a shaadi, or a fresh stock lot for your own shop — tell us the quantity and date, and we will quote a per-piece rate the same day.
